title: Moho project file (.mohoproj / .animeproj)
description: Root schema for a Moho project file. Despite the extension, both are plain JSON. See docs/moho-project-file-format.md §1-3 for the evidence base and §1's version-generation table. Validated against 19 real sample documents spanning format version 1021 through 1045 (moho/ in this repository) - see schema/README.md for the validation report and what each version generation omits.

antialiasing.description: Project-wide render-quality toggle. Shares its flat name with the PER-LAYER `MeshLayer.antialiasing` (layer.schema.json) - probed TOGETHER (both flip in one document, since tools/probe_field.py matches by literal key name across the whole tree, not by JSON path): forcing every `antialiasing` site in Bandit.mohoproj from true to false left frame 25 byte-identical. That rules out a combined effect but cannot attribute a null result to one owner over the other; see docs/moho-project-file-format.md §4 for the caveat and MeshLayer.antialiasing's own entry, which is NOT re-annotated from this row (no x-moho-registry-conflict-waived needed since both occurrences reach the same disposition).

noise_grain.description: Film-grain noise amount. Must be written as an INTEGER - a float value (e.g. 0.5) made Moho's headless render exit 0 without producing an output file at all, the same silent failure a channel/plain-field type mismatch produces elsewhere in this format; an integer value renders normally and moves pixels.
noise_grain.x-moho-evidence: docs/moho-field-probes.md: noise_grain=5, 1 site, Bandit.mohoproj frame 25, AFFECTS RENDER

pixelation.description: Project-wide render-time pixelation amount. Shares its flat name with the PER-LAYER `LayerEffects.pixelation` (layer.schema.json, a ValChannel) - the two cannot be varied together through tools/probe_field.py (a value valid for one is the wrong JSON shape for the other, and the combined document fails to render at all with no output file). Isolated by testing each independently on a hand-edited copy of Bandit.mohoproj with the OTHER owner's occurrences removed: THIS (project-wide) owner is inert; the per-layer owner (see LayerEffects.pixelation) affects rendering. Do not copy one owner's disposition onto the other from the flat name alone - see docs/moho-project-file-format.md §4.
pixelation.x-moho-evidence: docs/moho-field-probes.md: pixelation=20, 1 site, Bandit.mohoproj frame 25 (layer_effects.pixelation removed from every layer first, isolating the project-only site), inert

global_render_style_fill_style.description: A document-wide style override applied at render time. Observed as the integer 0 in every one of the 19 sampled documents (re-checked directly against the raw JSON - an earlier pass of this schema mistakenly reported seeing an empty string "" in some samples). Typed as [string, integer] defensively, since a single observed value across 19 files does not prove the value set is closed to 0. Not read by moho2svg.py, which would ignore it and could produce visibly wrong colours if a document ever sets it to something meaningful.

DocumentViewState.description: Editor viewport state: exactly 48 DocState_* keys in every one of the 19 sampled documents. Twelve are document-global (grid, playback range, viewport split); the remaining 36 are nine per-quadrant families suffixed 0-3, one set per pane of Moho's four-way viewport split (quadrant 0 is the single/active pane - it is the only one with a non-zero zoom in any sample). Pure UI state: NOT read by moho2svg.py, and it does not affect exported geometry.

AnimatedValues.description: Document-level channels: camera and a document-wide timeline-markers string. Every sample has exactly one keyframe (frame 0) on all five - i.e. an implicit fixed, unmoved, unzoomed camera in every sampled document. NOT read by moho2svg.py, which therefore renders with an implicit fixed camera regardless - untested against a document that actually moves/zooms the camera.

camera_track.description: Camera position. The default is {0, 0, 3.732051} = {0, 0, 2 + sqrt(3)}, chosen so that (2 + sqrt(3)) * tan(15 degrees) = 1 exactly and the visible half-height is therefore exactly 1 Moho unit. ANIMATED in 12 of the 46 sample documents. Applied by both exporters; see docs/moho-animation-and-transform.md section 9 for the measured projection.
camera_track.x-moho-evidence: moho2svg.py:5276 in Document.camera_channel (trace: out/traced_keys.json, see tools/trace_fields.py)

camera_pan_tilt.description: Camera pan/tilt offset, alongside camera_track/camera_zoom/camera_roll. Every sampled document keeps it at its default {0,0}, but forcing it to {0.3, 0.3} moves pixels - it is a real, currently-UNAPPLIED camera field (see the AnimatedValues description above: moho2svg.py implements a fixed camera and does not read this channel at all).
